claims.claim: Born in Buenos Aires on 8 June 1957
claims.note: Buenamusica: Nació en Buenos Aires, Argentina, el 8 de junio de 1957. Single source, as recorded in person.json.

claims.claim: Telefe announced 24 contestants for MasterChef Celebrity in September 2026; he was one of them
claims.note: Señal dateline 9 SEP 2026; 24 participants; Alejandro Lerner in the confirmed list.

claims.claim: Raúl Porchetto discovered him in 1974 and invited him to Reino de Munt
claims.note: Buenamusica 1974 entry.

claims.claim: Around 1977 he played with Soluna; joined Sandra Mihanovich's group in 1980; formed La Magia 1981-1982; solo from 1982
claims.note: Buenamusica entries for 1977, 1980, 1981-1982.

claims.claim: Todo a pulmón came out as a single in 1983
claims.note: Buenamusica 1983 entry.

claims.claim: Travelled to the US in 1985 to study music and jazz; Konex award as rock composer of the decade the same year
claims.note: Buenamusica: to form himself musically and learn about jazz; Konex award.

claims.claim: Juntos para siempre was the theme of La banda del Golden Rocket in 1990; Amor infinito came out in 1993
claims.note: Buenamusica 1990 and 1993 entries.

claims.claim: La Nación (November 2001): life split between Argentina and the US, about eight years in hotels, Magic hotel album, El poder de los sueños on Disney radio for Latin America
claims.note: Article dated 24 November 2001; all details present.

claims.claim: In 2002 he sang Hoy es adiós with Carlos Santana
claims.note: Buenamusica 2002 entry.

claims.claim: 20 años came out in 1999, the year Campeones de la vida won a Martín Fierro
claims.note: Buenamusica 1999 entry.

claims.claim: Discography: Si quieres saber quien soy (2000), Lerner vivo (2002), Buen viaje (2003), Canciones para gente niña (2006), Enojado (2007), En vivo Gran Rex (2011), Autentico (2016)
claims.note: Each album and year appears in the Buenamusica biography.

claims.claim: Autentico in 2016, the year he appeared on Bailando; Los sueños del ayer soundtrack of Cuéntame cómo pasó in 2017
claims.note: Buenamusica 2016 and 2017 entries.

claims.claim: Wanda Nara hosts; jury Damián Betular, Germán Martitegui and Maru Botana
claims.note: Señal: con la conducción de Wanda Nara; jury named.

claims.claim: Crónica: Pía Shaw confirmed his place on A la Barbarossa; quotes on ignorance, courage, YouTube and not fearing mistakes
claims.note: Article dated 8 September 2026; quotes match.

claims.claim: Perfil (6 October 2026): hot oil splashed Maru Botana's face; his proposal was among the three lowest rated
claims.note: Article dated 06-10-2026; splash and ranking confirmed.

claims.claim: Eliminated fourth on Tuesday 27 October 2026 in a final duel with Grego Rossello; lemon pie challenge
claims.note: Canal26 and Exitoina confirm position, challenge, duel and Rossello's dish.

claims.claim: He blamed nerves, a nervous crisis and confusing egg whites with yolks; jury said dough undercooked, lemon cream wrong consistency, wrong quantities
claims.note: Rionegro jury criticism and nerves; Canal26 egg mix-up.

claims.claim: Said his plate was ugly but his own
claims.note: Canal26: Es feo, pero es mío.

claims.claim: In his farewell said feeling like a student again was an experience to keep; fellow contestants applauded and performed one of his songs
claims.note: Rionegro farewell paragraph.

claims.claim: Telefe ran the farewell under a headline quoting him feeling like a high school student again
claims.note: mitelefe.com headline quoting him on secundaria.

claims.claim: FAQ: 69 years old as of 29 October 2026
claims.note: Arithmetic from the confirmed birth date.

summary: All body and FAQ claims match their cited sources. Adds the Crónica quotes, the 2001 La Nación context on his years in the US, and a clear account of the elimination.
